status: Frozen design; actual builds/configs registered with real runner before each query-compute release.

variants.range: Existing V2, W1024,256 score/merge workers, uniform positions, capacity128.
variants.mono: Existing canonical U64 GPUSparse adaptation, upstream92bb87b, BLOCK_PL512, batch1. Not unmodified released GPUSparse.
variants.csr: Existing fullbound executable, execution_mode0(exhaustive),B32,32scorethreads,256selection threads. Add only accurate fixed batch_size1 runtime reporting; kernel/timed loop unchanged.

correctness.synthetic: Eight inherited unique-term/doc fixtures (including empty corpus) plus hand-computed uint64-ID case; each implementation k10,1round,0warmups, internalVERIFY1 and independent complete ordered IDs/scores. Duplicate-posting fixture excluded only from shared native-loader domain; full corpus independently proved multiplicity1.
correctness.runtime_rejections: One intentional, exactly attributed mismatch per adapter before query outputs: range score_threads, mono query_count, CSRbatch_size. No precreated continue file.
correctness.full: All500calibration queries,1round,0warmups,VERIFY0 to reuse completed exhaustive CPUreference rather than recomputing it in C++ for every process. Every result compared externally to the fixed full CPUoracle; all unique returned query/doc scores independently recomputed with Python integers. Native adapter also retains its own post-run checks. Internal not_checked remains explicit. No timing starts until all three pass.
correctness.domain: Guarded U32 and literal U64 remain distinct physical labels. Explicit corpus/query/bound/canonical-output certificate required for domain-qualified comparison; original runner BLOCKED record retained. Native float/unspecified tie contract never accepted by this certificate.

timing_boundary: Host query construction through complete scoring, selection/merge, original numeric-ID results, D2H and synchronization. Index load/upload, gate, file writes and independent checking excluded and separately recorded. Device-event spans differ and are diagnostics only, never compared as matched GPU spans.
availability: Before each process require targetUUID/model/capability, no target compute context and modeled core/application bytes plus1GiB(C++) or1.5GiB(native)free. While occupied wait600seconds between automatic checks; no competing benchmark or repeated model polling.
monitoring: One passive one-second per-process sampler on CPU1 when available. Record clocks/power/memory, PID/PGID and foreign contexts. Only timing runs require sampled owned context; very short synthetic runs may end between samples and are not latency evidence. Any sampled foreign context makes timing ineligible, independent of latency; preserve it and retry after idle with fresh registered tag at most3replacements. Missing/error monitor evidence stops. Sampled absence is not exclusive-GPU proof. No independent crash watcher/immediate-failure-detection claim.

analysis.primary: Geometric paired range/baseline latency ratios over3processes x500queries; each entry is its20-round measured median.
analysis.bootstrap: 10000crossed process/query draws with replacement; multiplicity-weighted Cartesian product and linear quantiles. Conditional on calibration/session.
analysis.secondary: Descriptive mean/median/p95 over query/process medians; p95 is not serving latency tail. Report all cells and intervals; no tuning by observed latencies.
analysis.memory: C++tracked allocation bytes checked in every row; native Torch allocator/reserved peak since post-setup reset retained. Uniform one-second NVML own-process/board sampled peaks recorded separately, not exact physical peaks and not mixed with tracked/allocator quantities.

declared_changes.corpus: 1M subset to all8841823passages; original passage IDs/order and prepared query weights retained.
declared_changes.systems: Matched full-corpus comparison of retained range, canonicalU64adapted monolithic and exhaustive CSR. It is a system comparison, not an isolated codec ablation.
declared_changes.runtime: CSR fixed batch1 now explicitly reported before compute. Real project runner for every retrieval run; inherited stand-in is not used.
declared_changes.validation: Reuse fully qualified full CPUreference; real GPUcorrectness uses external oracle/true-score replay rather than repeated exhaustive CPU computation inline.
declared_changes.scoring: No scoring/selection algorithm change or output-contract relaxation. Domain-limited exact arithmetic equivalence is explicit and evidence-bound.
declared_changes.input_roles: Use qualified frozen hashes for every run. canonical_gsp is the actual index for literal backends; add an index role only for the encoded range representation. The runner hashes each actual input before/after compute without reading a duplicate GSP alias twice.

unsupported.full_byte_B16: Dense plane15848416906bytes alone exceeds4070board12878610432bytes. Unsupported by modeled capacity, not an observedOOM.
unsupported.full_byte_B32: CSRcore5458614690+plane7924208453=13382823143bytes exceedsboard before other allocations. Unsupported by modeled capacity, not observedOOM.
unsupported.chunking: Not performed; any future chunked method must include transfer/preparation/merging costs in a separately registered matched treatment.

limitations: 500calibration only;6480held-out queries untouched; no held-out freeze/evaluation.
No full-collection externalCPU-BMP or unmodified/native-floatGPUSparse speed claim. CanonicalU64adaptation can change cost versus upstream; a guarded canonicalfloat32 alternative is unmeasured.
Not every precision/pruning variant is included. Only named full-byte resident B16/B32 modes have been ruled out by capacity; coarse/refinement variants need their own full-memory audit.
Full-source posting bodies not independently replayed: importer assertions, independent import fixtures, full GSP checks and CIFFDocRecord replay have distinct coverage.
No exact physical VRAM peak, traffic, occupancy or isolated bottleneck proof; profiles, k/batch scaling and secondGPU remain separate.
Threeprocesses on a sharedGPU; residual clock/cache/contention effects and conditional inference remain.
Range query_transfer_bytes1028 is logical sizeof(QueryArgs), not measured bus traffic/full argument block; an empty corpus need not transfer it.
technical_failures: Stop and preserve; separately review/fix technical failures for up to3repair attempts with fresh run directories. Do not replay unchanged known-broken code or tune valid slower/null results away.
publication: Only after complete protocol plus independent local raw/provenance/statistical validation; existing user standing authorization then permits push/PR/merge.
